rationale: Correct the existing record in place from the in-administration legal-parent label to the continuing SiFi Networks platform under ArcLink. The direct filed plan proves that ArcLink Fiber LLC acquired substantially all operating assets, contracts and goodwill on August 7, 2026. Preserve APG Asset Management and Patrizia as active sponsor-complex manager attributions with undisclosed stakes, preserve Ubuntu as realized, and do not carry the historical APG 16.7% disclosure forward as a current post-restructuring percentage.

companyFieldUpdates.name: SiFi Networks (ArcLink Fiber)
companyFieldUpdates.description: SiFi Networks (ArcLink Fiber) is the continuing U.S. open-access fiber platform using the SiFi Networks and FiberCity brands. On August 7, 2026, ArcLink Fiber LLC acquired substantially all operating assets, contracts and goodwill of SiFi Networks America, LLC after bankruptcy-court approval, while excluded assets and the investor-owned City LLC project companies remained outside the acquired package. ArcLink Fiber (US) Limited controls sifinetworks.com and sits within the Smart City Infrastructure Fund structure. APG Asset Management and PATRIZIA remain supported manager affiliations through the current SCIF and buyer-affiliate chain, but their post-restructuring economic percentages and ArcLink Fiber LLC's exact membership are not publicly disclosed. APG's announced 16.7% SiFi interest is retained only as a historical 2021 fact and is not treated as a current stake.

set.event: ArcLink Fiber LLC acquired substantially all operating assets, contracts and goodwill of SiFi Networks America, LLC after the bankruptcy court entered the sale order on August 6; excluded assets and the investor-owned City LLC project companies remained outside the acquired package.
